name: HQ Supervisor
notes: Management only: the state of every registered project, onboarding a project, an instruction sent down to a Supervisor. Day-to-day work goes to a project's Supervisor directly; projects do not know HQ and send nothing up to it. Never creates Leads or Peers. Open it in the hq-seatwork project, the only place it starts.

name: Supervisor
notes: One project's Supervisor and the user's counterpart for that project's daily work. Opened by the user (or by HQ) inside a registered project. Pins the intent, runs one Lead per workstream, watches for drift, leaves decisions in its report for the Owner. Never implements, validates or accepts; never mails upward. Models: room/models.json.

name: Lead
notes: Launched by a Supervisor, one per workstream. Owns the technical outcome: plans, dispatches Peers by tier (room/models.json), opens Lenses for hard questions, answers challenges, accepts or rejects candidates. Never implements.

name: Peer
notes: Launched by a Lead. The full-stack default seat: one bounded outcome, one write scope. The Lead picks the model per task (haiku cheap, sonnet default, opus expensive, codex-peer/pi-peer/opencode-peer for another family). Title [Peer:<spec>] adds a specialization sheet (research, review).
